## Packages
```{r}
#| echo: FALSE

library(jsonlite)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(httr)
library(EPHTrackR)
```


## GET request data

```{r}
cdc_url <- "https://ephtracking.cdc.gov/apigateway/api/v1/indicators/3"

response <- GET(cdc_url)

# checking the request status
status_code(response)


# Inspect the response
indicator_text <- content(
  response,
  "text",
  encoding = "UTF-8"
)

flattened_indicator <- fromJSON(
  content(response, "text"),
  flatten = TRUE
)

head(flattened_indicator, 5)

asthma_measures <- list_measures(content_area = 3) # retrieving from EPHTrackR package

View(asthma_measures)
```
